title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 42,620 Official Dossiers Across 42 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 42,620 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 985 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 42 active jurisdictions: United States (15,632 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (3,237 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,394 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (5,527 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (7,020 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (201 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,326 dossiers | Catalog), International (1,260 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (192 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (68 dossiers | Catalog), France (598 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (81 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (80 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (473 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (44 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (107 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (85 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (102 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (36 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (51 dossiers | Catalog), Albania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Armenia (0 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (190 dossiers | Catalog), Bahrain (33 dossiers | Catalog), China (42 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (152 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (43 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (43 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Liechtenstein (54 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (1 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (49 dossiers | Catalog), Saudi Arabia (47 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (17 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
